title.value: Clones in Deep Learning Code: What, Where, and Why?
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the beginning of the paper and reflects the study's focus on investigating code clones in deep learning code.
title.quote: Clones in Deep Learning Code: What, Where, and Why?

analysis.description: This paper examines the characteristics and impacts of code clones in deep learning systems, comparing their prevalence and distribution with traditional systems, and studies their association with bugs. It also provides a taxonomy of code clones within deep learning applications and identifies phases of development where cloning poses high risks.

type.justification: The study involves practical analysis of cloned code in deep learning systems and their comparison with traditional systems, highlighting prevalence, distribution and impact through collected data and statistical analysis, rather than theoretical formulations.
type.quote: We compare the distribution of clones from the perspectives of clone types and their locations. To gain further insights into the reasons behind developers’ code cloning practices in the studied deep learning systems, we randomly select six deep learning projects to perform a manual analysis of their code clones.

name.justification: The research focuses on empirical analysis of software engineering practices, specifically code cloning in deep learning systems.
name.quote: This paper presents the first empirical study on DL code clones, where one performs a comparative study of the distribution and bug-proneness of clones in deep learning and traditional software systems.

name.justification: The study is centered around code clones within deep learning systems and examines how these clones affect such systems.
name.quote: Given the complexity of deep learning systems, concerns are growing regarding the high energy consumption by deep learning systems.

name.justification: The paper examines code clones, which are a major aspect of maintaining software systems, as well as their frequency and distribution.
name.quote: It is very important to understand the characteristics and potential impacts of code clones on deep learning systems.
